== Summary ==
Only surviving copy (thumbnail, 50×38). Decipher's caption: "[[Thaddeus Chenoweth|Thad Chenoweth]] of Colorado Springs, CO was a Star Wars CCG finalist in '97 and once again this year." Photo: Decipher. See [[DecipherCon 1999]] and [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]].
